{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The pirates have infiltrated! They've taken a prisoner and they want to exchange him for YOU! You have to do something!|Colonel Sheray, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:NPT">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Publish 17: "New Player Tutorial"}}</ref>}}
'''Jerga Dronus''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Dronus boarded an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in an attempt to secure an important [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] from Imperial custody.<ref name="SWG:NPT" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Jerga Dronus]]
Jerga Dronus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Dronus was added to the game when the developers revamped the "New Player Tutorial" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> During the tutorial, new players were tasked with killing Dronus to help them get accustomed to the game mechanics. Because Dronus spawned under the "desert_thug_newbie" template, the character's appearance was randomized.<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> However, Dronus was removed alongside with this tutorial when the developers introduced a completely [[:w:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|new tutorial]] with the release of the "[[:w:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005" />
